# Oxide Launcher 1.19.0

## New renderer: Silica (Vulkan FG)

Silica pairs ONIGAMI-class translation (shared core, separate data dir) with win-fg optical-flow frame generation (The412Banner, MIT, vendored): 2x/3x/4x interpolated presents, flow model + quality preset + pacing controls, all applying live. FG hooks the game's own Vulkan swapchain (Minecraft 26.2+); without one Silica runs as pure translation and says so. Old EGL-blend FG removed.

## Real-time FPS with generated frames

Advanced meter shows measured Native vs Displayed from win-fg layer counters (never native x multiplier), plus in-tab diagnostics (package proof + live counters + reason).
